_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

A Journey Home#000.src: ...you were scared of those, once upon a time. What a difference time makes.
A Journey Home#000.dst: ...vous en aviez peur, autrefois. Comme le temps change les choses.

A Journey Home#001.src: You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#001.dst: Vous pouvez apporter cette armure à l'Identificateur d'objets juste là, puis la porter une fois identifiée.
A Journey Home#001.speaker: Soldier

similar.text: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.

A Journey Home#002.src: This gate marks the Fruman Border- you must make sure you aren't spotted from this point onwards.
A Journey Home#002.dst: Cette porte marque la frontière de Fruma- à partir d'ici, assurez-vous que personne ne vous voie.

A Journey Home#003.src: Sounds like new recruits are walking down the path! You better find somewhere to hide before they spot you!
A Journey Home#003.dst: On dirait que de nouvelles recrues arrivent par le chemin! Trouvez vite une cachette avant qu'elles ne vous repèrent!

A Journey Home#004.src: This is your chance, the gate's open! Follow the Caravan Driver!
A Journey Home#004.dst: C'est votre chance, la porte est ouverte! Suivez le cocher de la caravane!

A Journey Home#005.src: ...you need to escape. Strike while the commander is busy, and find a way out!
A Journey Home#005.dst: ...il faut fuir. Frappez pendant que le commandant est occupé, et trouvez une sortie!
A Journey Home#005.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#006.src: You have emptied {p} of soldiers. You must escape before someone discovers what has happened here. The only way out is forward.
A Journey Home#006.dst: Vous avez vidé {p} de ses soldats. Vous devez fuir avant qu'on découvre ce qui s'est passé ici. La seule issue est d'avancer.

A Journey Home#008.src: What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
A Journey Home#008.dst: Quel est cet endroit? Quelle technologie, on peine à imaginer sa fabrication.

A Journey Home#009.src: The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
A Journey Home#009.dst: Le cocher de la caravane semble avoir disparu... vous trouverez peut-être quelque chose en fouillant les wagons mécanisés?

A Journey Home#010.src: {p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
A Journey Home#010.dst: Les relations de {p} avec Fruma se résument aux généreux contingents de recrues envoyées combattre ici la corruption de Wynn.

A Journey Home#011.src: They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way you first arrived?
A Journey Home#011.dst: Ils vous ont fermé la porte. Pas moyen d'entrer par ici... Mais si vous repreniez le chemin de votre première arrivée?

A Journey Home#012.src: ...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
A Journey Home#012.dst: ...Ah. Je vois. Alors je suppose que... ça s'est mal passé. Les autres sont-ils tous revenus?

A Journey Home#014.src: Is there anything I can do for you today?
A Journey Home#014.dst: Que puis-je faire pour vous aujourd'hui?

A Journey Home#016.src: ...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
A Journey Home#016.dst: ...quelque chose vous titille l'esprit. Ne dormiez-vous pas déjà ainsi à votre arrivée?

A Journey Home#017.dst: Enquêtez sur la Fruma Gate à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#018.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#018.dst: Explorez les environs de votre point d'arrivée à Wynn.

A Journey Home#020.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#021.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#021.dst: Ce boulot est impossible!! Qu'est-ce que je fais ici?!
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#022.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#022.dst: Ah! Vous êtes soldat, c'est ça? Écoutez, je- C'est, c'est juste un moment très difficile.
A Journey Home#022.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#023.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#023.dst: Cette, cette situation me dépasse complètement! Je ne sais pas comment je vais gérer ça...
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#024.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#024.dst: Bref, je, euh, je suppose. De quoi avez-vous besoin?
A Journey Home#024.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#026.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#026.dst: Oh. Oh non. Ah, je, voyez-vous, ça va poser problème, je crois. Que devez-vous faire à la frontière, au juste?
A Journey Home#026.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#027.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and-
A Journey Home#027.dst: J'imagine mal ce qu'il vous faut là-bas, mais quoi que ce soit, ça attendra! Cette foreuse Corkian ne marche pas, Paxon est coincé, et-
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#028.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#028.dst: Écoutez, je... désolé de m'être emporté. Je suis formé aux opérations militaires, pas aux éboulements, mais personne d'autre n'était dispo!
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#029.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#029.dst: Même l'expert en démolition que j'ai engagé est coincé, alors tout, tout part de travers et je ne sais pas quoi faire.
A Journey Home#029.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#030.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#030.dst: Vous voyez cette nouvelle entrée là-bas? L'expert, Paxon, y est depuis presque aussi longtemps que je m'acharne sur cette machine.
A Journey Home#030.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#031.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#031.dst: Si vous pensez faire mieux qu'un expert, allez lui parler, mais je crois bien que vous devrez annuler vos projets.
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#032.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#033.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#033.dst: Si vous devez vraiment atteindre la frontière, le mieux est de parler à Paxon dans la nouvelle entrée de la grotte.
A Journey Home#033.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#034.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#034.dst: Mais c'est un expert, alors votre affaire devra attendre, je pense. Vraiment, vraiment désolé!
A Journey Home#034.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#035.src: Oh no, not another one- I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it-
A Journey Home#035.dst: Oh non, pas encore un- Je me fiche de ton grade, ce que tu demandes est impossible! Même pour moi, c'est-
A Journey Home#035.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#036.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#036.dst: Attends, tu ne fais pas partie des... Tu es juste un soldat ordinaire. Tu cherches juste à passer, c'est ça?
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#037.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#037.dst: Autant abandonner! Ça n'arrivera pas. Aucune chance. Tu perds ton temps, et je vais te dire exactement pourquoi.
A Journey Home#037.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#038.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#038.dst: Tu vois ce rocher bleu là-bas? C'est un point de rupture. Si je pouvais y faire sauter ces explosifs, ça ouvrirait un passage.
A Journey Home#038.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#039.src: They're gone. Hurry down the path!
A Journey Home#039.dst: Ils sont partis. Descendez vite le chemin!

A Journey Home#040.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#040.dst: Mais apparemment, toutes ces installations sont si importantes que les abîmer, ou les DÉPLACER, est inacceptable!
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#041.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#041.dst: Et pour que je sois 'surveillé' pendant que le lieutenant répare la foreuse, le détonateur DOIT rester ici.
A Journey Home#041.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#042.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#042.dst: Alors je dois enchaîner un stock limité d'explosifs jusqu'au rocher, sans faire sauter aucune installation!
A Journey Home#042.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#043.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#043.dst: J'essaie depuis des heures sans avancer d'un pouce! Je suis l'un des meilleurs du métier, pourtant! C'est ridicule!!
A Journey Home#043.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#044.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
A Journey Home#044.dst: Si tu veux perdre ton temps, voilà mon stock d'explosifs. Libre à toi d'essayer, mais tu ferais vraiment mieux de partir.
A Journey Home#044.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#045.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.
A Journey Home#045.dst: Utilisez la TNT pour ouvrir un chemin à travers la grotte.

A Journey Home#046.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#046.dst: Toujours là-dessus? Quoi, il te faut un rappel? Je n'ai rien de mieux à faire.
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#047.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#047.dst: Donc, le rocher bleu est assez tendre pour céder aux explosifs. Mais le détonateur est coincé ici.
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#048.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#048.dst: Il faut donc utiliser le TNT Placer pour enchaîner les explosions depuis le détonateur, sans toucher tentes, caisses ni murs.
A Journey Home#048.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#049.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#049.dst: Tu peux aussi regarder une TNT posée pour voir son rayon d'explosion.
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#050.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#050.dst: Mais vu l'étroitesse du passage entre certaines installations, ça n'arrivera jamais.
A Journey Home#050.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#051.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#051.dst: Comme je disais, tu ferais mieux de retourner tranquillement au château. Si moi je n'y arrive pas, je doute que tu fasses mieux.
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#054.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#054.dst: Halte! D'où sortez-vous? Il y a eu un éboulement par là, non?
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#055.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#055.dst: Un nouveau chemin, hein? Je ne pensais pas que vous auriez à faire par ici, mais je ne dirai pas que je suis ingrat.
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#056.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#056.dst: Il a même écrasé le nid de grook, là. Je vis de rations depuis quelques jours. Alors, où allez-vous?
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#057.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#057.dst: La frontière? Si vous y allez, ce doit être une affaire officielle importante. Mais elle devra peut-être attendre.
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#058.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#058.dst: Le pont a été réparé à la va-vite. Il risque de ne pas supporter votre poids. Maintenant que l'éboulement est dégagé, on pourra peut-être le réparer correctement...
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#059.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back- whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#059.dst: Mais ça prendra du temps. A votre place, je ferais demi-tour- votre affaire ne vaut pas votre vie, après tout.
A Journey Home#059.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#061.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#061.dst: Dites, je crois que je vous reconnais, en fait. C'est rare dans ce métier.
A Journey Home#061.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#062.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#062.dst: Vous êtes sûr que ça en vaut la peine? Ce pont est terriblement branlant. Je ne voudrais pas vous perdre.
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#063.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#063.dst: Hé, toi là-bas! Viens me parler avant de passer.
A Journey Home#063.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#064.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#064.dst: Hé, toi! Viens d'abord me parler, recrue!
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#065.dst: Aller ou retour, j'ai l'ordre strict d'arrêter les soldats et de vérifier leur équipement avant qu'ils continuent.
A Journey Home#065.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#066.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#066.dst: Aucune exception, sous aucun prétexte. Surtout depuis l'éboulement de l'autre côté de la rivière!
A Journey Home#066.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#067.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#067.dst: Rien n'est plus important que ta vie, et continuer sans être bien équipé pourrait te la coûter!
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#069.src: Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#069.dst: Bon, laisse-moi jeter un oeil pour voir si ce matériel est réglementaire.
A Journey Home#069.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#070.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#070.dst: Bon, laisse-moi regarder si ce matériel est réglementaire.
A Journey Home#070.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#071.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#071.dst: Hmm... Ah, ouais, de l'usure partout... Armure pas astiquée... L'arme a l'air de pouvoir tomber en morceaux à tout moment...
A Journey Home#071.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#072.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#072.dst: Je m'étonne que tu aies fait trois mètres dehors avec ces breloques rouillées! Ce n'est pas comme ça qu'on se protège!
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#073.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#073.dst: Écoute, il y a un coffre à butin dans la grotte juste là, alors vas-y et trouve-toi un équipement digne de ce nom.
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#074.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#074.dst: ...ah oui, hein? Eh bien, tu devrais jeter un autre coup d'oeil un peu plus loin.
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#075.src: See? Now no more guff about levels- you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#075.dst: Tu vois? Fini les excuses de niveau- soit tu t'équipes bien, soit tu ne passes pas! Pas question que tu risques ta vie.
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#077.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#077.dst: On trouve du bon matos dans les grottes, comme celle juste à côté de moi, alors file.
A Journey Home#077.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#078.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#078.dst: Comme je disais, aller ou retour. Quoi qu'il arrive, équipe-toi en pillant cette grotte avant de continuer.
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#079.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#079.dst: Parfait. Il y a un coffre à butin dans cette grotte, tu devrais y trouver tout ce qu'il te faut. Au boulot!
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#080.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.
A Journey Home#080.dst: Explorez la grotte pour trouver du butin.

A Journey Home#081.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#081.dst: Entre dans la grotte et ouvre le coffre à butin.
A Journey Home#081.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#082.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#082.dst: Ça a l'air d'être ça. Tu peux apporter cette armure à l'Identificateur d'objets juste là, puis la porter une fois identifiée.
A Journey Home#082.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#083.src: Though, since you seem to be headed back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#083.dst: Cela dit, vu que tu as l'air de retourner à la frontière... je dois te demander pourquoi. C'est plutôt inhabituel. Mieux vaut rentrer à {p}.
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#084.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#084.dst: Si d'autres recrues te voient aller dans l'autre sens, elles pourraient être perdues, ou découragées. Tu ne voudrais pas risquer ça, hein?
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#085.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#085.dst: Tu es sûr que ça en vaut la peine? Tu devrais peut-être rentrer en ville.
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#086.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.
A Journey Home#086.dst: Évitez les recrues de Fruma sur le chemin.

A Journey Home#087.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#087.dst: ...recrutent des soldats de Fruma pour l'effort de guerre. Apparemment, ça va très mal là-bas. Ça me rend nerveux...
A Journey Home#087.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#088.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#088.dst: Je ne vais pas sous-estimer des cadavres ambulants, mais ça ne peut pas être si sombre, non?
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#089.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass through this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#089.dst: On verra bien une fois cette porte franchie, je suppose. Elle marque la frontière... Respire, respire...
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#090.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#090.dst: ...sais quelque chose sur Wynn? Je n'ai eu aucun briefing.
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#091.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...an R?
A Journey Home#091.dst: Je me souviens de rumeurs... Un grand héros. Son nom commençait par... un R?
A Journey Home#091.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#092.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#092.dst: On posera la question dès que possible. L'information est la clé de la guerre.
A Journey Home#092.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#093.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#093.dst: ...cocher minable. Je le plains, mais il dit qu'il heurte toujours ce rocher. Si tu veux mon avis, c'est sa faute.
A Journey Home#093.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#094.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#094.dst: Je pense plus aux repas qu'aux essieux. Je n'ai rien mangé depuis des jours, on dirait. Pourvu que ce soit court...
A Journey Home#094.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#095.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#095.dst: Eh bien, s'il conduisait mieux, tu n'aurais pas à marcher si loin le ventre vide! Dépêchons-nous qu'on te serve un festin, hein?
A Journey Home#095.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#096.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#096.dst: Attends, c'est qui? Pourquoi il vient de la frontière??
A Journey Home#096.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#097.dst: Cachez-vous du cocher de la caravane.

A Journey Home#098.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#098.dst: ...et ce sont les derniers pour aujourd'hui.
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#099.src: Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#099.dst: Beaucoup de paires, aujourd'hui. Huit autres en attente... Ce sera pour demain.
A Journey Home#099.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#100.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#100.dst: Ce satané rocher, encore... Et la même satanée réplique. Un jour, ils me laisseront peut-être changer. Quelle plaie...
A Journey Home#100.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#101.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#101.dst: Et voilà qui est réglé. Et maintenant, en route... vers le foyer que je choisis. Et nul ennui ne m'y suivra.
A Journey Home#101.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#102.dst: Explorez au-delà de la Fruma Gate.

A Journey Home#103.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#103.dst: T'as vraiment pas compris le message, hein?
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#104.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#104.dst: Tu te crois malin? T'as même pas vu que j'étais resté en arrière pour guetter, hein? Je suis pas né d'hier.
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#105.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#105.dst: Écoute, c'est pas la première fois que ça arrive- Tu vois le genre. Quelqu'un devient curieux, revient sur ses pas.
A Journey Home#105.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#106.src: ...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
A Journey Home#106.dst: ...Je n'exigerai de vous qu'une seule chose. Quoi qu'il arrive... revenez vivant.

A Journey Home#107.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#107.dst: Au cas où t'aurais pas remarqué, tout ça est censé être un aller simple. Le pont, l'éboulement, tout le monde qui essaie de te décourager.
A Journey Home#107.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#108.src: It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#108.dst: C'est pas prudent d'être ici- Après tout, dans ton groupe de trois, c'est pas toi qui as eu le droit de rester. Ouais, j'ai su les résultats du tournoi.
A Journey Home#108.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#109.src: He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
A Journey Home#109.dst: Il dort à poings fermés. Vous pourriez sonner une cloche d'église à deux doigts de sa tête qu'il ne se réveillerait pas.

A Journey Home#110.src: That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
A Journey Home#110.dst: Ça a l'air d'être ça. Vous voyez? Ce n'était pas si dur. Bien, maintenant!

A Journey Home#111.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#111.dst: Alors... t'as deux choix, mon gars. On peut garder ça entre nous. On peut. Tu repars tout droit vers {p} et je dirai rien.
A Journey Home#111.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#112.src: Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
A Journey Home#112.dst: Hélas, je crains d'avoir les mains liées. Je ne peux pas faire grand-chose- souvenez-vous de ce que j'ai dit à la réunion.

A Journey Home#113.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though- it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#113.dst: Ou tu peux vivre dangereusement et me suivre dans le train pour {p}. Mais décide-toi vite- il part bientôt.
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#114.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#114.dst: Si je te vois dans le wagon des passagers, eh bien... ce sera réglé, et tu verras bien ce qui en sortira.
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#115.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
A Journey Home#115.dst: Rejoignez le cocher de la caravane dans le wagon des passagers à [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#116.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#116.dst: Dernière chance de te dégonfler. C'est ton choix?
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#117.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#117.dst: Eh ben, t'as plus qu'à prendre le long chemin du retour vers {p}.
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#121.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#121.dst: Tu connais le dicton sur la curiosité qui a tué le chat. T'es du genre à croire que la satisfaction le ressuscite?
A Journey Home#121.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#122.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#122.dst: Eh bien, 'minou', t'as pas trouvé la crème- juste les chiens de garde.
A Journey Home#122.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#123.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#123.dst: Intrus à Fruma, tu es en état d'arrestation! Avance!
A Journey Home#123.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#124.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#124.dst: Tu croyais vraiment que le cocher était de ton côté, intrus? Quel imbécile. On t'a donné toutes les chances de renoncer, et pourtant te voilà. Allons-y.
A Journey Home#124.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#126.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#126.dst: J'ai des nouvelles urgentes de la porte.
A Journey Home#126.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#127.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#127.dst: Si c'est vraiment si urgent, parlons.
A Journey Home#127.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#128.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#128.dst: Soldats! Surveillez l'intrus. J'ai toute confiance en vous.
A Journey Home#128.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#132.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#132.dst: Je peux t'aider en quelque chose?
A Journey Home#132.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#133.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#133.dst: Hm. Ça fait pas de mal, j'imagine. Mais fais attention, hein?
A Journey Home#133.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#134.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#134.dst: C'est notre foyer, ici. J'apprécierais pas que tu viennes tout chambouler, compris?
A Journey Home#134.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#135.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#135.dst: ...on s'en sort pas mal, vu les circonstances. Il fait beau, j'imagine. Le festival approche.
A Journey Home#135.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#136.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#136.dst: Mais c'est pas nos affaires, au fond. Si t'as besoin de rien d'autre, je vais te prier de t'en aller.
A Journey Home#136.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#137.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#137.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#138.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#138.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#139.src: Hoh, oh well. Might I help you with something?
A Journey Home#139.dst: Oh, ma foi. Puis-je vous aider?
A Journey Home#139.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#140.src: Ah, completing some assorted metalworking projects. There always seems to be something to replace or maintain around here...
A Journey Home#140.dst: Ah, je termine quelques travaux de métallerie divers. On dirait qu'il y a toujours quelque chose à remplacer ou entretenir ici...
A Journey Home#140.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#141.src: Though, I certainly am no expert! But I can handle the tools well enough, and that is all that is needed for the task.
A Journey Home#141.dst: Mais je ne suis certainement pas un expert! Je manie assez bien les outils, et c'est tout ce qu'il faut pour la tâche.
A Journey Home#141.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#142.src: Farewell, stranger! I hope that you will return home safely.
A Journey Home#142.dst: Adieu, étranger! J'espère que vous rentrerez chez vous sain et sauf.
A Journey Home#142.speaker: Mora

A Journey Home#143.dst: Je jette juste un coup d'oeil.

A Journey Home#147.src: You don't hear anything moving on the other side of the door.
A Journey Home#147.dst: Vous n'entendez rien bouger de l'autre côté de la porte.

A Journey Home#148.src: Greetings, {u}. It is always an honour to have you in our halls.
A Journey Home#148.dst: Salutations, {u}. C'est toujours un honneur de vous recevoir en nos salles.
A Journey Home#148.speaker: Ragni's King

A Journey Home#149.src: So, Tasim has stayed behind then. I'm to suppose you're worried for his safety, in amongst any other worries you might have.
A Journey Home#149.dst: Ainsi, Tasim est resté là-bas. Je suppose que vous vous inquiétez pour sa sécurité, parmi vos autres soucis.
A Journey Home#149.speaker: Ragni's King

A Journey Home#150.src: Although you are not the first to wish to return to Fruma, I have not had any recruits who went to investigate come back satisfied. Or, in a scant few cases, at all.
A Journey Home#150.dst: Vous n'êtes pas le premier à vouloir retourner à Fruma, mais aucune des recrues parties enquêter n'est revenue satisfaite. Ni même, pour quelques-unes, revenue tout court.
A Journey Home#150.speaker: Ragni's King

A Journey Home#151.src: I may only grant you access to the pass you took to first come here. Simply take the door and do what you must. I know not what you will find...
A Journey Home#151.dst: Je ne peux vous ouvrir que le passage par lequel vous êtes arrivé. Franchissez la porte et faites ce que vous devez. J'ignore ce que vous trouverez...
A Journey Home#151.speaker: Ragni's King

A Journey Home#152.src: I'd advise you be cautious. The Queen's correspondence has been...not unkind, but forceful- And considering the circumstances...
A Journey Home#152.dst: Je vous conseille la prudence. Les lettres de la Reine ont été... pas désobligeantes, mais insistantes- Et vu les circonstances...
A Journey Home#152.speaker: Ragni's King

A Journey Home#153.src: The door to the pass between here and Fruma is down the hall, across from the fireplace. Come back alive- that is an order as King.
A Journey Home#153.dst: La porte du passage entre ici et Fruma est au bout du couloir, face à la cheminée. Revenez vivant- c'est un ordre royal.
A Journey Home#153.speaker: Ragni's King

A Journey Home#154.src: ...ah. It's enchanted...that's odd, given what you've seen, but the guards are looking your way now. You probably shouldn't do that again.
A Journey Home#154.dst: ...ah. Il est enchanté... étrange, vu ce que vous avez vu, mais les gardes regardent vers vous. Mieux vaut ne pas recommencer.

A Journey Home#156.src: No one seems to know you're here.
A Journey Home#156.dst: Personne ne semble savoir que vous êtes ici.
